description: Retrieve YouTube search results with video titles and metadata.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

search_query.description: YouTube search query, e.g. 'elon musk interview'.

sp.description: Pagination/filter token; pass next_page_token from a previous response.

name: youtube_search
title: YouTube Search API
